brief:
Israeli occupation forces stormed Jenin city and several towns across the governorate, according to Shehab Wire. The operation represents a continuation of military incursions into the northern West Bank region, an area that has experienced repeated raids in recent months.

The scale of the operation and involvement of specific military units remained unclear. No immediate reports detailed the number of troops deployed, specific locations targeted within the governorate, or the stated purpose of the raid. Local sources did not immediately report casualties or arrests resulting from the incursion.
